data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Minos was a king of Crete known for his cruelty and unjust laws. The name 'Minni' is derived from this mythological figure, symbolizing rebellion against unjust rules and standing up for what is right.

data.cultural_impact: The name 'Minni' is an uncommon one in the Christian world, with its origin rooted in Greek mythology. It embodies the spirit of rebellion against unjust rules and represents the courage to stand up for what is right. This can be a powerful inspiration for those facing adversity and challenges in their personal lives. The name carries a rich cultural heritage, reminding us of the strength and resilience of those who defy unjust authorities and fight for their beliefs.
data.spiritual_significance: 'Minni' as a Christian name can carry a deep spiritual significance, symbolizing the strength and courage to stand up for one's faith and beliefs in the face of adversity. It represents the biblical theme of 'standing firm in the faith' (1 Corinthians 15:58) and 'not being moved by fear' (Philippians 4:14). Moreover, it can be a reminder of the power of prayer and faith, as demonstrated by the story of Minos in Greek mythology who was humbled and transformed by the intervention of the god Apollo. Overall, the name 'Minni' can inspire a deep sense of spiritual resolve and courage in those who bear it.
